name: cinder_veil
theme: a volcanic caldera country at night — down a cooling lava river to basalt terraces, into a lava tube and a single pumice stone, through its nested gas pockets into an Apollonian bubble foam, out across a supernova remnant's burning lace, back past a fire-veined rogue planet into the ash clouds over the caldera

registers.name: caldera_country
registers.scene: volcanic caldera country at night seen from high above, a black shield of cooled rock spread from ridge to ridge, glowing orange vent fissures branching across it in every direction, grey ash plains between the ridges, a molten river winding along the caldera floor
registers.target: a molten lava river, a bright orange channel

registers.name: lava_river
registers.scene: a molten lava river running down a black rock channel, its bright orange flow broken into dark cooling crust plates, bright sparks above the surface, stepped terraces of black basalt standing on either side, grey ash banks below them
registers.target: a stepped basalt terrace, black hexagonal columns

registers.name: basalt_terraces
registers.scene: wide terraces of black basalt stepping down in tiers, a pavement of packed hexagonal column tops on every step, drifts of grey ash strewn across them, ember light in the deep cracks between the columns, a dark opening low in the terrace wall
registers.target: a dark cave mouth, a black arched opening

registers.name: lava_tube
registers.scene: a lava tube running back into the dark, ribbed walls of glassy black rock, a thin stream of molten orange along the floor, pale rubble stones strewn over the ledges on either side, ember light washing the low ceiling, empty, no one present
registers.target: a pale grey pumice stone, rough and pitted

registers.name: pumice_stone
registers.scene: a pale grey pumice stone resting in cinder rubble, its rough skin drilled through with round gas pockets of every size, more stones scattered around it on black sand, ember light from below catching their rims
registers.target: a round gas pocket, a smooth-walled hollow

registers.name: vesicles
registers.palette: warm orange through pale grey glass
registers.scene: a cavern world of round gas pockets inside pale volcanic glass, wide smooth hollows opening into smaller hollows in every direction, thin glass walls between them lit warm orange from within, fine ash dust settled in the deepest pits
registers.target: a knot of tiny nested bubbles, circles inside circles

registers.name: gasket_foam
registers.scene: a foam of glass-thin circles nested inside circles, every gap between three touching rings filled by a smaller ring and that gap by one smaller again, pale glass rims burning orange, black depth behind the lace

registers.name: remnant_lace
registers.palette: burning orange and white on black
registers.scene: a supernova remnant strewn across the black, tangled lace filaments of burning gas layered in torn sheets one over another, thin bright rims where the sheets fold, dark voids between the strands, cold stars scattered behind them
registers.target: a dull red star, dark cinder patches crusted over it

registers.name: cinder_ring
registers.palette: dull red and ember orange on black
registers.scene: a dying ember star ringed by a broad disk of burning cinder debris seen at a shallow tilt, banded rings of glowing dust circling it with dark gaps cut between them, embers scattered through the dust in every direction, the star's dull red light bleeding out through a hazy corona with no clear rim, black space beyond
registers.target: a black planet veined with molten orange
registers.loop_target: a dying ember star ringed by a broad disk of burning cinder debris, embers scattered through banded rings of glowing dust

registers.name: rogue_planet
registers.scene: a black rogue planet in deep space, long veins of molten orange branching across its night side, grey ash storms spread over its dark continents, a thin fiery limb along its edge, faint stars behind it
registers.target: a grey ash cloud, a wide torn sheet

registers.name: ash_sky
registers.scene: an ash cloud deck seen from high above, torn grey sheets spread over black land, orange light from the fissures below staining their undersides, tall columns of ash standing up through the layers
registers.target: a branching orange fissure, a bright crack in black rock

music_theme: a volcanic night — a deep subterranean drone under slow struck-metal pulses, an ember shimmer rising into the bubble-foam break, settling back to low ash-soft strings
